entities.summary: Shahram Shabpareh is an Iranian singer, songwriter, composer, and actor. He is a pioneer of Iranian pop music, having begun his career in the 1960s. Alongside his brother Shahbal Shabpareh, he co-founded the music group Black Cats. Shabpareh also appeared in several films and, following the 1979 Iranian Revolution, immigrated to Los Angeles, where he continued his career. As a producer and composer, he has collaborated with prominent Iranian artists, including Shohreh Solati, Ebi, Siavash Ghomayshi, Sattar, Googoosh, Leila Forouhar, Shahram Solati, and Andy.
